The '''Blaster Brothers''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] company that was led by [[Kord Murdok]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During an assignment on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the company was wiped out by [[nekghoul]]s, with only Murdok escaping.
